1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { parse } from '../src/parse.js'
3	
4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  it('parses a simple two-row CSV', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
7	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
8	      ['1', '2', '3'],
9	    ])
10	  })
11	
12	  it('returns an empty array for empty input', () => {
13	    expect(parse('')).toEqual([])
14	  })
15	
16	  it('parses a single row with no trailing newline', () => {
17	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
18	  })
19	
20	  it('parses a single field', () => {
21	    expect(parse('hello')).toEqual([['hello']])
22	  })
23	
24	  it('parses empty fields', () => {
25	    expect(parse('a,,c')).toEqual([['a', '', 'c']])
26	  })
27	
28	  it('parses trailing empty field', () => {
29	    expect(parse('a,b,')).toEqual([['a', 'b', '']])
30	  })
31	
32	  it('parses leading empty field', () => {
33	    expect(parse(',b,c')).toEqual([['', 'b', 'c']])
34	  })
35	
36	  it('treats trailing newline as end of last row, not a new empty row', () => {
37	    expect(parse('a,b\n1,2\n')).toEqual([
38	      ['a', 'b'],
39	      ['1', '2'],
40	    ])
41	  })
42	
43	  it('handles quoted fields containing commas', () => {
44	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
45	      ['name', 'quote'],
46	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
47	    ])
48	  })
49	
50	  it('handles escaped double quotes inside quoted fields', () => {
51	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
52	      ['id', 'note'],
53	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
54	    ])
55	  })
56	
57	  it('handles newlines inside quoted fields', () => {
58	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
59	      ['id', 'bio'],
60	      ['1', 'line one\nline two'],
61	    ])
62	  })
63	
64	  it('handles quoted empty field', () => {
65	    expect(parse('a,"",c')).toEqual([['a', '', 'c']])
66	  })
67	
68	  it('handles a fully quoted simple field', () => {
69	    expect(parse('"a","b","c"')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
70	  })
71	
72	  it('handles only escaped quotes in field', () => {
73	    expect(parse('""""')).toEqual([['"']])
74	  })
75	
76	  it('handles CRLF line endings', () => {
77	    expect(parse('a,b\r\n1,2')).toEqual([
78	      ['a', 'b'],
79	      ['1', '2'],
80	    ])
81	  })
82	
83	  it('handles multiple newlines inside quoted field', () => {
84	    expect(parse('"a\nb\nc"')).toEqual([['a\nb\nc']])
85	  })
86	
87	  it('handles consecutive escaped quotes', () => {
88	    expect(parse('"a""""b"')).toEqual([['a""b']])
89	  })
90	})
